text:
maya: quick heads-up — I'm starting a canary for rwd-v5.2-int4 (quantized NF4) on prod tomorrow morning. Local perf: ~2.1-2.4x cost reduction, but noticed 95th pct latency uplift on long docs. need to lock canary gates before flip.

sam: nice. do we have any early A/B quality numbers vs v5.1 fp16?

maya: short smoke: QA F1 down ~0.8% on our longdoc slice, hallucination alerts up ~3% (small sample ~2k requests). latency p95 up 120ms on >1024 token queries.

kevin: that matches perf tests I ran on a7g. cost per token looks great. tail increase seems tied to KV cache misses on multi-turn long contexts.

dena: proposed guardrails: auto-fallback if (1) aggregate F1 drop >1.5% OR (2) hallucination rate increase >7% OR (3) p95 latency increase >200ms vs baseline. also suggest a "soft hold" if any metric drifts >0.5% for 30m.

liz: +1 to soft hold. also recommend staged ramp plan: 0.5% -> 3% -> 15% with 30m hold and canary-bot smoke at each step. if soft hold triggers, pause and run targeted evals on the failing slices.

maya: bump: canary-bot ran a preliminary smoke today on 500 requests, results: cost -2.2x, avg latency +30ms, p95 +110ms, QA F1 -0.9%, hallucination +2.7%. posting summary:

canary-bot: smoke results:
- sample size: 500
- avg cost per req: 0.46x vs baseline
- avg latency: +30ms
- p95 latency: +110ms
- QA F1: baseline 72.3 -> candidate 71.6 (-0.7%)
- hallucination alerts: baseline 1.9% -> candidate 4.6% (+2.7pp)

sam: numbers look acceptable for an initial tiny burn. My suggestion: run 0.5% for 2h (not 30m) so we get more signal on hallucinations, then follow liz's ramp if stable. Also add a rerank-guard: if top-3 rerank disagreement goes >5% escalate.

kevin: FYI cost win gives us headroom to tighten latency SLO via batching tweaks. I can land a runtime tweak to avoid cold KV misses during the canary window.

dena: update on auto-fallback thresholds: make them configurable per-route, defaulting to: f1_delta = -1.5, halluc_delta_pp = +5.0, p95_ms = +250. Fallback action: immediate switch to v5.1 fp16 for the affected route, and alert on #incidents.

maya: here's a rollout snippet I propose for console (pseudo-yaml):
```
rollout:
  steps: [0.005, 0.03, 0.15]
  hold_minutes: 30
  metrics:
    - name: qa_f1_delta
      compare_to: baseline
      threshold: -1.5
      aggregation: weighted
    - name: hallucination_pp_delta
      threshold: 5.0
    - name: p95_latency_ms_delta
      threshold: 250
  auto_fallback: true
```

liz: can we make the first step a quiet-burn (no logs to main SLA dashboards) for 60m? want to avoid false alerts during warmup.

maya: yes — quiet-burn for 60m on 0.5% then enable full telemetry after step 1. Sam: can you run the longer 0.5% burn and share A/B breakdowns by slice?

sam: on it. I'll run a 2h 0.5% early morning run and post slice-level diffs (longdoc, shortanswers, code, summarization).

kevin: I’ll schedule the runtime KV fix to land tonight behind a feature flag so we can flip during the burn if needed.

dena: note — make sure rollback playbook is primed: runbook link https://internal.redwood/rollbacks and ensure oncall has the canary toggle.

maya: thanks all. plan: 1) run 2h quiet 0.5% burn tomorrow 06:00 UTC, 2) evaluate metrics (sam + canary-bot), 3) proceed with staged ramp if within thresholds. will update thread with results. :rocket:
